properties.name: Claims, superseded mirrors and shared premises read right (PR A2): a refreshed mirror keeps what its source withdrew, claimed and withdrawn readings, independence over premises, a source named but not read, an unsourced objection contests
properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-22 ("Go with your recommendations (for all the open decisions)") queued PR A; on 2026-10-23 ("Go with your recommendations on all of them", "I agree with both") he accepted req:a-claim-made-by-a-named-party-and-not-yet-verified-reads-claimed, req:an-objection-taken-as-given-with-no-pinned-source-contests-and-never-defeats and dec:idea-a-source-says-what-kind-of-support-it-gives option (c) plus "named, not read". Every item traces to an accepted node: req:a-superseded-mirrored-judgment-is-kept-and-what-rested-on-it-reads-reason-lost (all five parts), the claimed requirement, the three trial facts on independence (Navier–Stokes (b), four colour (e), Gettier (a)), the source decision and the objection requirement. Causes, read in code: mirror_surface deleted every previously held node before re-creating (so local edges died with them) and its guard read incoming edges only (PREMISE_OF leaves the judgment); proof_reading read a replaced claim whose own step held as contested (any_holds with truth unknown); independence_of compared steps and cited results only; add_inference removed a cleared key from the map it then MERGED, so the stored key survived; cited_sources counted any DOCUMENTS as citing; objections_within let a taken-as-given objection hold outright. The guard against recurrence: crates/reflow2-core/tests/claims_and_shared_premises.rs (19 tests on the trial exports and the two surfaces) and the MCP wire test; every regression was first measured on origin/main bd44e8154 with a scratch test (independence holds on all three trials, `[]` left the list, stmt-c unproven, no withdrawn reading, not_read still cited, Heawood unsourced defeated, the refresh deleted KJ1–KJ4 and the edges, reasons_lost 0, unknown_seeds). Judgement calls recorded in the PR: definitions/axioms and the theorem's own setting do not break independence (heat, Arrow and logic readings unchanged); the four colour Heawood objection is pinned by S1 as exported, so it was reproduced with its documenting edges removed. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: PR A2 of "proofs and arguments read right" (branch feat/claims-and-shared-premises). (1) mirror_surface refreshes in place: local edges into still-published nodes survive; a withdrawn node is KEPT, marked superseded_by_surface, with a snapshot and a deprecation ChangeEvent; the guard counts every local edge either way (PREMISE_OF included) and refuses unless accept_withdrawal; what rested on it reads reason-lost (rests_on_withdrawn; loop_status reasons_lost, premises_withdrawn); propagate_from seeds from it; a requirement `replaces` supersedes reads superseded and is not published. Measured on the KESTREL-ASSESS v1/v2 surfaces: 0.90.0 deleted KJ1–KJ4 and the decisions' PREMISE_OF and CONSUMES edges, reasons_lost 0, unknown_seeds; now all kept, 3 decisions reason-lost, re-grounding clears it. (2) claimed_by (Requirement, Constraint, Inference): NS (C) unproven → claimed ("claimed by OpenAI, unverified"); a what-if dropping OpenAI's claims reads it open; status_over_time read back; Kempe's 1879 step reads withdrawn 1879–1890 by Heawood's objection. (3) independence compares premises: Gettier case 2 vs 1 and NS Lean vs natural-language routes holds → false naming the shared premises; definitions, axioms and the theorem's own setting named in shared_setting (four colour Coq vs RSST names the 633 configurations there); independent_of: [] clears. (4) Artifact not_read and source_reliability / information_credibility: a source named but not read never cites; graded D–F or 4–6 it pins nothing. (5) An objection taken as given with no pinned source contests and never defeats. Toolsnap: add_requirement, add_constraint (claimed_by), add_inference (claimed_by), add_artifact (not_read, source grade), mirror_surface (accept_withdrawal). Stamp: Artifact gains two enum properties (refused by an older binary only when populated); A1 already moved it.
